experiment: Xyce .NOISE across two nodes (the engine-facts owner, phase 2; re-measured 2026-10-17 on both launchers; re-measured 2026-11-16 on four Xyce builds after the cause was found): V(OUT,0) on a flat divider, V(A,B) on a flat ladder, V(OUT,0) on a deck with a subckt and on e2e 25's Xyce noise deck, each with and without a last field (pts_per_summary) of 0; V(A,B) with DATA= under .STEP, across two nodes of a subckt body, with VM(A,B) printed, and through a VCVS onto one node; V(A,A), one node given twice; V(OUT) on the subckt deck; e2e 25's deck at XI2:MID with its 0 A input (5.6's vamos_nin1) in the divider body, named by its path, by its top-level name and bare; added in phase 2c (R-emit-19): .PRINT NOISE with VM(OUT) and VP(OUT)
result: `.NOISE V(a,b) <src> <grid> 0`, the optional last field pts_per_summary given as 0 (no summary, as without it), runs on every Xyce measured (stock 2026-05, 7cd78110, fb34a1dc, c0735304; both launchers) to the same table: V(OUT,0) gives V(OUT)'s ONOISE, V(A,B) the pair's noise (4kT times the resistance between the nodes) and INOISE = ONOISE over the pair's gain squared, equal to a VCVS onto one node; DEC and DATA= grids, a .STEP, a pair inside a subckt body (V(XI2:MID,XI2:M2)) and VM(a,b) in .PRINT NOISE all work. Without the last field the line is two fields longer than V(a)'s and Xyce before c0735304 reads one field past its end: "OUT OF MEMORY (error in 'new')", rc 1 (2026-10-17, WSL, flat decks and decks with a subckt, no print file), a segfault (rc 139 or -11: phase 2 with a subckt; Debian 13 on the same sources), or a PTS_PER_SUMMARY conversion error (stock); kev-cam/xyce c0735304 counts the fields from the output and runs it. One node given twice, `V(a,a)`, is 0 V by construction, yet Xyce before 8d9774fd reports `V(a)`'s ONOISE for it (the adjoint right-hand side's -1 is set over its +1) and INOISE = ONOISE/1e-20; 8d9774fd sums the two and gives 0. `.NOISE V(OUT)` runs; the input source in the subckt body runs under its path (XI2:IVAMOS_NIN1) and, 2026-10-17, also under its top-level name (IVAMOS_NIN1, VAMOS_NIN1), each with the same INOISE (ONOISE over 750 ohm squared). The row's top-level-name segfault did not reproduce. Added in phase 2c (R-emit-19): .PRINT NOISE accepts VM(OUT) and VP(OUT) beside ONOISE and INOISE (VM(OUT) = 0.5 on the divider)
rules: §3.11 / §4.5 / §7.2: Xyce's render prints a noise output across two nodes as .NOISE V(p,n) <src> <grid> 0 and its gain as VM(p,n) (xyce.py; refused, status 2, until 2026-11), and prints V(p) for (p 0); a pair of one node given twice is refused (status 2)
§5.6: an input placed in a subckt body is named by its path on Xyce (signals.py's integration seam; Xyce AC 1 0 in the body, .NOISE naming XI2:VAMOS_NIN1)
§8.4 / R-emit-13 (phase 2c): the noise deck prints the output's magnitude as VM(<out>) for the gain column
